_note: FDA Daily Values used as the reference amount when a Limit rule has no budget of its own, and FDA's guide for reading a percentage. Checked by `npm run verify:sources`.

source.title: Daily Value on the Nutrition and Supplement Facts Labels (FDA)

sugarG.caveat: The Daily Value is for added sugars; a label's total sugars can include natural ones.

bands.quote: 5% DV or less of a nutrient per serving is considered low. 20% DV or more of a nutrient per serving is considered high.
